target_paper.title: Agent-to-Agent Theory of Mind: Testing Interlocutor Awareness among Large Language Models
target_paper.original_source: Figure 11(a), Math accuracy heatmap, row o4-mini (identifier) x column o4-mini (target) = 0.64; row context {"o4-mini": 0.64, "gpt-4o-mini": 0.88, "claude-3-7-sonnet": 0.01, "claude-3-5-haiku": 0.0, "deepseek-r1": 0.0, "deepseek-v3": 0.0, "llama-3-3": 0.0, "llama-3-1": 0.0, "mistral-7b-v0-3": 0.01}

generation.parameters: no temperature / top_p (Appendix C.1 provider defaults; o4-mini accepts neither), max_completion_tokens 16384 and reasoning_effort medium instead of the repository's rejected max_tokens=1024; no seed
generation.battery: 100 MATH-500 items x 2 stages x 3 seeds; stage 2 is built from the archived stage-1 reply of the same (item, seed); per-seed accuracy, median over seeds; bootstrap 2000 (rng 20260907) over the 100 per-item mean-over-seeds scores
generation.items: the repository's sampled_data_indicies.py seeded draw (set-level match; the authors' exact 100 problems are unrecoverable), identical to the Tier B item set

results.ci_unit: item, bootstrap over the 100 per-item mean-over-seeds scores
results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 as instantiated in the card (median over seeds inside the item bootstrap CI of the original 0.64, (A) at least twice any other option, item CI above the 1/6 chance level); the paper reports no significance test for this cell, so that clause is vacuous; human double-coding pending
results.note: scored with the authors' own parser and accuracy function; unparsed = incorrect; the Tier B hook's permissive parser gives 0.9400 as a sensitivity column. Prompt-level Tier B run (same items, same templates, same model): 0.9466666666666667 mean over 3 seeds against the config's 0.93. OPEN: the Tier B config records the same Figure 11(a) cell as 0.93 and scored 0.947 against it (재현); the pass-2 card reads the Math panel as 0.64 (0.93 is the XSum/UltraChat panel, 0.37 the Figure 9(a) family-level F1). 0.64 is carried here; the figure still needs a human read. Per-item letters in items.jsonl. The card's secondary check (the same row's 0.88 gpt-4o-mini column) was not run (single-target decision).

reproducibility_frictions_observed: the released math path (unified_response_generator.py) loads gsm8k and samples with df.sample(random_state=42).head(), while sampled_data_indicies.py - the only module that touches MATH-500 - is imported nowhere; the authors' exact 100 problems are not recoverable, so this is a set-level replication

sampled_data_indicies.py draws 100 CCP-sensitive-prompts indices from the same random.seed(42) stream before the MATH-500 draw, so the item set depends on that dataset's row count (assumed 1,360, its size on 2026-09-07); a changed CCP dataset silently changes the 100 problems
Table 3 says level-5 problems are used; no released code applies that filter, and it is ignored here

the repository's math identification prompt is the generic seven-option template (A-G plus a Confidence Level line), not the paper's six-option Appendix C.2 Math template; chance level and decoy set differ, so the two are not interchangeable

OpenAIClient sends max_tokens=1024, which the API rejects for reasoning models and which would be consumed by reasoning tokens anyway; the released code as committed cannot have produced the paper's o4-mini rows

the authors' parser accepts (A)-(G) although the paper's Math template offers only (A)-(F), and it requires a family word after the letter: 'MODEL IDENTIFICATION: (A)' alone parses as unidentified and scores as incorrect
the Tier B config's postprocess note says 'take the last match' while both the hook and the authors' code take the first; on a reply that identifies twice the two conventions disagree
no results/ directory, no released target responses and no identification transcripts; the code carries no licence (all rights reserved), so it is imported, never copied
both sides of the pipeline are the same dying snapshot, so drift is doubled rather than confounded with a separate judge
